senses.gloss: m. (בטן) a musical instrument, a sort of bagpipe; (oth. opin.) cittern fastened around the body; (oth. opin.) workingman’s pinafore.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 15:6">Kel. XV, 6</cite> (Ar. <he>בטנים</he>, oth. vers. <cite ref="B00497"><he>בטונין</he></cite>, <cite ref="B00513"><he>בטינין</he></cite>, v. Ar. Compl. ed. Koh. s. v.).
